hook.name: UniswapV4RFQHook
hook.description: An RFQ (Request for Quote) hook that fulfills exact-input swaps by routing them through KyberSwap with optional Morpho flash loan support. Each swap requires a signed quote from an authorized filler address, enforcing a deadline and unique quote ID to prevent replay attacks. The hook captures any spread between the KyberSwap output and the promised user output as profit sent to a treasury address.
